provenance.label: USGS Global Vs30 (Heath et al. 2020, 30" -> 0.025°)
provenance.source: Heath, D.C., Wald, D.J., Worden, C.B., Thompson, E.M., Smoczyk, G.M. (2020) A global hybrid VS30 map with a topographic slope-based default and regional map insets, Earthquake Spectra 36(3), 1570-1584
provenance.license: USGS public domain; assembly repo CC0 1.0 (github.com/usgs/earthquake-global_vs30 LICENSE.md)
provenance.nativeResolution: 30 arc-sec (~0.008333 deg), water coded 0; slope-based default with regional map insets (Italy incl.)
provenance.downsample: mean of valid (>0) 3x3 source pixels per 0.025 deg cell; no valid pixel -> 0 (nodata, app falls back to the 500 m/s estimate)
provenance.note: the assembled product paints far-field ocean with a constant fill (600.0 m/s exact); only exact-fill cells confirmed as water by a GEBCO 2025 water-mean mask are zeroed to nodata — near-shore slope-derived product values stay so coastal stations keep real reads (fill masking verified per-station 2026-09-25)
